name: sol9-checkpoint-final-review
goal: Checkpoint descriptions and titles wrap fully while all advanced rule rows appear in viewport evidence

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Advanced captures clip condition and action rows. Long fixtures contain repeated filler and a short title; real long text must wrap completely.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: The existing catalog checked disclosure state and scrollTop, not visible rule rows, realistic long text, or overflowing field values. Strengthen those same cases.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Record 43f77ef4a894163ff0e9b5a850ff1618fef3ea0737aac34df8e56e0cb90933fc: three long cases fail horizontal text fit; all expanded advanced cases pass.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Content-sized canonical textareas wrap title and description; modal and rule controls retain their shared implementations. Only product source and its contract changed after red.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Record 30b0a6c7a85202bcebd1cd4c575b7bd43ab14b5e48792170a1413fbd530ce7aa passes all six unchanged cases atb1d90d736b. Inspected every original before and after image; advanced rows and long text are fully visible.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
